— 🇮🇶 / 🇮🇶 / 🇮🇷 NEW: After mediation from IRGC Quds Force Commander Ismael Qaani, the issue surrounding Kata’ib Hezbollah’s presence in Jurf Al-Sakhr was peacefully resolved Contrary to some reports, Kata’ib Hezbollah has not withdrawn from the area, and will remain there. The resistance movement only agreed to redeploy part of its forces from Jurf Al-Sakhr towards the Syrian border, on the strategic Al-Qa’im sector. To replace Kata’ib Hezbollah forces, the 72nd and 79th brigades of the PMF (part of the Iraqi Armed Forces) were deployed to Jurf Al-Sakhr. Both of these brigades either have direct affiliations with Katai’b Hezbollah or have decent to very good relations with them. In short, it seems that Prime Minister Al-Zaidi backed down and opted for a symbolic settlement. @Middle_East_Spectator
